title: Island Designer edit/apply path, ACNH 1.0.0

scope.question: Trace post-unlock FieldMakeToolKit into edit validation, grid mutation, cancel/undo/apply, and save/day state.
scope.method: Bounded static analysis of supplied 1.0.0 ELF/NSO, parsed EventFlow, existing native analysis artifacts, and ROMFS BCSV/asset evidence. No game execution, save execution/mutation, or Godot changes.
scope.conclusion: EventFlow and action/error metadata are proven through tool selection. The current-binary join from tool/input state to a LandMaking cell writer and current save serializer remains open; the dump does not support a native edit/apply fixture.
